Name: difficulty option for bundles
Author: adjd12
Description:
[u][b]Description:[/b][/u]

I found the bundles of the community center too easy so I worked on this mod to make them harder (It also affects the missing bundle).
But you also have the option to make them easier.

The mod does not reset the progress you have already made with the bundles before the installation.

It is the first my first mod, i'm waiting for your feedback. :)


[b][u]options:
[/u][/b]

-﻿"Veryhard": I am starting a new game to test it. It will take you a lot of patience(many in game years) and maybe some strategies to complete the community center. rewards include a stardrop!

-"FreeA": You will need one piece of wood to complete all the bundles. It also removes the material rewards.
-"FreeB": You will need one piece of wood to complete each bundle. The vanilla rewards are conserved.
-"FreeC": You will need one piece of wood to complete each bundle. It Gives you a stardrop for each bundle completed(A total of 36 stardrops).

-"Vanilla÷2": You will need 2 times less different types of item to complete each bundle.
-"VanillaX2":  You will need 2 times more of each type of item to complete each bundle.
-"VanillaX5": You will need 5 times more of each type of item to complete each bundle.
-"VanillaX10": You will need 10 times more of each type of item to complete each bundle.
-"VanillaX100": You will need 100 times more of each type of item to complete each bundle.

[u]Requirement:[/u]

SMAPI and Content Patcher

[b]Compatibility:[/b]

I made the mod for Stardew Valley 1.4.3 but it should work for 1.4.X

[b][u]Installation:

[/u][/b]1. Unzip it in your Mods file
2. Do not forget to write the name of the option you want in the config.json (VanillaX100 by default)
3. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Don't forget to make your choice in the config.json
